fixed_selection: highest archived LLM confidence, then lexicographically smallest skill id
update_rule: cumulative development mean AUC, retaining incumbent on exact ties; no evaluation feedback
claim_boundary: Offline persistent skill-selection component using archived LLM proposals. No new LLM generation, weight training, novel skill synthesis, task-disjoint confirmation, or wet-lab execution. All tasks were used in historical development. Development compute/reveals are extra and explicitly reported.
